blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Aerial imagery provides complementary spatial context for autonomous driving by exposing road structure beyond the immediate perception range of onboard sensors. Yet map construction from aerial imagery, aerial-assisted online HD mapping, and cross-view localization are typically studied on separate data and benchmarks. We introduce KITScenes Aerial, an extension of the KITScenes Multimodal dataset that augments synchronized onboard sensor data, vehicle poses, and rich Lanelet2 map annotations with spatially associated aerial imagery and higher-resolution neural representations, providing a common basis for a variety of research tasks. Our mapping evaluation focuses on all 53 KITScenes map classes across different model designs, spatial ranges, and aerial resolutions, while retaining compatibility with the widely used three-class setting. Representative baselines show that aerial context is particularly beneficial for fine-grained and extended-range mapping, more than doubling 53-class mAP at the larger mapping extent. Higher-resolution aerial imagery yields a further 4.3 mAP (+24 %) improvement, with gains extending to challenging map elements such as traffic lights. We additionally evaluate cross-view localization under geographically disjoint conditions, where an adapted fine-grained feature-matching baseline achieves a mean translation error of 5.13 m. KITScenes Aerial thus enables unified study of aerial and ground-level information across complementary mapping and localization tasks. Project page: https://kitscenes.com/aerial

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Onboard sensors of autonomous vehicles are limited by occlusions, field of view, and perception range.
Aerial imagery provides a complementary view of road environments and has become relevant across three closely related research directions: (i) aerial-only map construction, where high-definition (HD) maps are constructed directly from aerial observations [ 44 , 2 ] ; (ii) aerial-assisted online map construction, where aerial context complements onboard sensors [ 8 , 19 , 20 ] ; and (iii) cross-view localization, where ground-level observations are related to geo-referenced aerial imagery for vehicle pose estimation [ 7 , 41 ] . Although these directions pursue different objectives, they rely on overlapping combinations of aerial imagery, ground-level sensor data, vehicle poses, and map annotations.
blocks.zh:
自主飞行器的机上传感器受到隔离、视野和感知范围的限制。
空中图像提供了道路环境的补充观点,并已在三个密切相关的研究方向上变得具有相关性:(一) 空中专用地图构建,其中高清晰度(HD)地图直接由空中观测构建 [44,2];(二) 空中辅助在线地图构建,其中空中环境补充了船上传感器 [8,19,20];(三) 相视局部化,地面观测与车辆的地理参照航空图像形成估计[7,41]。 尽管这些方向追求不同的目标,但它们依赖于航空图像、地平面传感器数据、车辆和地图说明等重叠组合。

blocks.en: Early datasets including aerial imagery were typically designed around individual research settings, such as aerial-to-map reconstruction [ 11 , 2 ] or ground-to-aerial localization [ 40 , 26 ] . More recent datasets increasingly connect these previously separate domains by associating aerial imagery with autonomous vehicle (AV) recordings [ 44 , 8 , 18 ] or jointly providing ground-level and aerial modalities [ 5 ] . However, these extensions remain constrained by the properties of their underlying data, including map representation, geographic coverage, and the accuracy of the ground–aerial association. Previous work further reports pose-to-aerial misalignment and scene changes caused by temporal differences between ground and aerial acquisitions [ 35 , 38 , 7 , 18 , 31 ] as challenges for the field.
blocks.zh: 包括航空图像在内的早期数据集通常是围绕单个研究环境设计的,如从空中到地图的重建[11,2]或从地面到空中的局部化[40,26]. 较新的数据集通过将航空图像与自动飞行器(AV)录音[44、8、18]连接起来,或联合提供地面和空中方式[5],越来越多地将这些以前分开的领域联系起来。 然而,这些扩展仍然受到其基本数据的性质的限制,包括地图的显示、地理覆盖范围和地面-空中联系的准确性。 先前的工作进一步报告,由于地面和空中采购的时间差异[35、38、7、18、31]造成的空域错位和场面变化是实地面临的挑战。

blocks.en: We introduce KITScenes Aerial, an aerial extension of the KITScenes Multimodal dataset [ 34 ] . KITScenes Multimodal provides synchronized multimodal sensor data, vehicle poses, and detailed Lanelet2 [ 32 ] maps, including full topological connectivity and regulatory information exposed through a 53-class online mapping benchmark. KITScenes Aerial augments the dataset with freely available digital orthophotos at a ground sampling distance (GSD) of 20 cm / px 20\text{\,}\mathrm{cm}\text{/}\mathrm{px} , corresponding to the German DOP20 product specification [ 12 , 16 ] , while retaining the original sensor data, vehicle poses, map annotations, and dataset splits. In addition, we provide precomputed neural features extracted from higher-resolution imagery up to 8 cm / px 8\text{\,}\mathrm{cm}\text{/}\mathrm{px} .
blocks.zh: 我们介绍KITScenes Air,这是KITScenes多式联运数据集的空中延伸[34]. KITScenes Multimodule提供同步的多式传感器数据,车辆外观,以及详细的Lanelet2[32]地图,包括通过53级在线测绘基准暴露的完整的地貌连接和监管信息. KITScenes Air在地面采样距离(GSD)为20cm/px 20\text~,}\mathrm{cm}\text{/}\mathrm{px}时用可自由取取取的数字正反光片来增强数据集,与德国DOP20产品规格[12,16]相对应,同时保留了原始的传感器数据,车辆姿势,地图说明和数据集分. 此外,我们提供从高分辨率图像中提取的预计算神经特征,最高可达8cm/px 8\text~,}\mathrm{cm}\text{/}\mathrm{px}.

blocks.en: By combining aerial imagery with ground-level sensor data, vehicle poses, and rich map annotations within the same recorded environments, KITScenes Aerial provides a common basis for a variety of research directions. For map construction, we distinguish onboard-only, aerial-only, aerial-guided approaches using aerial imagery only during training [ 20 ] , and aerial-fused approaches combining aerial and onboard features [ 19 ] . We additionally evaluate fine-grained cross-view localization with a representative baseline [ 41 ] . The mapping experiments cover two settings: all 53 KITScenes map element classes derived from its Lanelet2 annotations and the widely used three-class HD map construction setting [ 27 , 23 , 43 ] , both evaluated across different spatial ranges and aerial imagery resolutions.

blocks.en: 2.1 Map Construction from Aerial Imagery
blocks.zh: 2.1 从空中图像学绘制地图

road geometry and infrastructure over large spatial areas. LaneExtraction [ 11 ] reconstructs routable lane-level street maps from aerial
imagery, while UrbanLaneGraph [ 2 ] predicts and aggregates
connected lane graphs for urban automated driving. OpenSatMap [ 44 ] extends aerial map construction toward fine-grained
vectorized road representations over large geographic areas. The levelX drone dataset family [ 1 , 15 , 28 , 21 , 6 ] further associates overhead observations with Lanelet2 or
OpenDRIVE map representations at local recording sites.

blocks.en:
Cross-view localization addresses geographic localization by matching
ground-level observations against geo-referenced aerial or satellite imagery.
Early datasets such as CVUSA [ 40 ] and
CVACT [ 26 ] established large-scale ground-to-aerial image
retrieval as a common evaluation setting. VIGOR [ 46 ] moved
beyond the commonly assumed one-to-one correspondence between centered ground
and aerial views and additionally evaluates localization by geographic
distance.

More recent work has progressed from image retrieval toward direct pose
estimation. Fervers et al. [ 7 ] transfer cross-view
localization to autonomous-vehicle data and estimate a vehicle’s 3-DoF
geo-pose from ground-based camera observations and aerial imagery. They augment multiple existing driving datasets with orthophotos and refine the vehicle poses with respect to the aerial reference. FG 2 [ 41 ] further addresses fine-grained cross-view localization by explicitly matching local features between ground-level and aerial views and estimating the relative 3-DoF pose from sparse correspondences. Subsequent approaches address cross-view pose estimation with different model designs and sensor modalities, including CCVPE [ 42 ] , RGB–LiDAR-based PIDLoc [ 17 ] , and VIRD [ 30 ] .

blocks.en: 2.4 Positioning of KITScenes Aerial
blocks.zh: 2.4 KITScenes空中定位

blocks.en: Although these research directions pursue different objectives, their data requirements substantially overlap. Aerial map construction relates overhead imagery to map annotations, aerial-ground map construction additionally incorporates ground-level sensor observations, while cross-view localization relies on the spatial correspondence between ground-level observations, aerial imagery, and vehicle poses. KITScenes Aerial brings these components together with the rich Lanelet2 annotations of KITScenes, providing a common data basis for at least three research directions that have largely been studied independently.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些研究方向追求不同的目标,但它们的数据要求相重叠很大。 空中地图的建造与地上图像与地图说明有关,空中-地上地图的建造还融入了地上传感器观测,而交叉视点定位则依赖于地上观测、空中图像和飞行器之间的空间对应。 KITScenes Air将这些组件与丰富的"Lanelet2"(KITScenes)说明相融合,为至少三个基本上独立研究的研究方向提供了共同的数据基础.

blocks.en: 3 KITScenes Aerial
blocks.zh: 3 KITS 飞机

blocks.en: KITScenes Aerial extends the original KITScenes Multimodal dataset [ 34 ] with georeferenced aerial imagery covering its recorded driving areas. The aerial modality is spatially associated with the original vehicle poses while retaining the KITScenes sensor data, annotations, coordinate conventions, and dataset splits unchanged. This combination brings together ground-level sensor data, geo-referenced vehicle poses, aerial imagery, and the detailed, standardized, and deployment-ready Lanelet2 map representation of KITScenes Multimodal, providing a common basis for aerial map construction, aerial-ground map construction, and cross-view localization.

blocks.en: 3.1 Aerial Imagery Sources and Acquisition
blocks.zh: 3.1 空中图像来源和获取

blocks.en:
The KITScenes recording areas are covered with digital orthophotos obtained from official state geodata services [ 12 , 16 ] . The public KITScenes Aerial release uses freely available digital orthophotos with a ground sampling distance of 20 cm / px 20\text{\,}\mathrm{cm}\text{/}\mathrm{px} (DOP20).
KITScenes Multimodal provides vehicle poses in EPSG:25832, matching the coordinate reference system of the orthophotos and enabling their direct spatial association. The resulting ground–aerial correspondence is qualitatively illustrated in Fig. 2 using LiDAR reflectivity from the onboard sensors.

KITScens记录区包括从官方国家地理数据服务获得的数字正反相片[12,16]. KITScens Air Release使用可自由取用的数字正反相片,地上采样距离为20cm/px 20\text~,}\mathrm{cm}\text{/}\mathrm{px} (DOP20).
KITScenes多式联运公司在EPSG:25832中提供了车辆,与正反相图的坐标参照系统相匹配并使得它们能够直接进行空间相接。 图2用船上传感器的LiDAR反射率从质量上说明了由此产生的地面-空中通信。

blocks.en:
For controlled resolution experiments, we additionally use higher-resolution municipal orthophotos available under a commercial license at a ground sampling distance of 8 cm / px 8\text{\,}\mathrm{cm}\text{/}\mathrm{px} . As illustrated in Fig. 1 , the municipal imagery provides higher visual quality than the freely available DOP20 imagery, with sharper structures and improved local contrast even at matched ground sampling distance.
Since the high-resolution RGB imagery itself is not redistributable, we release precomputed feature representations described in Sec. 3.2 and visualized in Fig. 1 and Fig. 4 . The higher-resolution imagery is used for the aerial image resolution ablation in Tab. 6 .
blocks.zh:

由于高分辨率的RGB图像本身无法再生,我们发布第3.2 Sec.所描述的预计算特征表述,并在图一和图一中可视化. 4 (韩语). 高分辨率图像用于Tab中的航空图像分辨率衰减. 6 (英语).

blocks.en: 3.2 Data Representation and Release
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 数据表示和发布

blocks.en:
The aerial coverage is derived from the vehicle trajectories with sufficient spatial margin to support large regions of interest. The imagery is provided on a north-up tile grid rather than as ego-centered,
heading-aligned per-frame crops with a fixed region of interest. This allows ego-centered and ego-aligned crops with configurable spatial extent to be generated for each frame, including extended mapping regions of up to 240 × 60 m 240\text{\times}60\text{\,}\mathrm{m} as recently explored in long-range map construction [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh:
空中覆盖源于飞行器轨迹,具有足够的空间空间空间来支撑大范围感兴趣的区域. 图像是在北上平板格上提供的 而不是以自我为中心
与固定利益区域对齐的每帧作物。 这使得每个框架都能产生以自我为中心、与自我相适应的、具有可配置空间范围的作物,包括最近在长程地图构造中探索的最长为240 × 60 m 240\text\times}60\text\,XQ mathrm{m}的扩展绘图区域。

blocks.en:
In addition to the RGB tiles, we provide two feature representations derived from the higher-quality imagery. DINOv3 SAT ViT-L/16 [ 36 ] features are released as tiled neural feature maps, preserving the continuous spatial organization of the aerial imagery rather than being cropped or aligned to individual ego frames. UNet++ [ 45 ] features from the ablation in Table 6 are provided as ego-centered 60 × 30 m 60\text{\times}30\text{\,}\mathrm{m} crops aligned with the onboard coordinate system. Their layout follows aerial inputs used in recent mapping approaches [ 8 , 18 , 20 , 19 , 13 ] ,
enabling integration with minimal adaptation.
blocks.zh:
除了RGB平面砖外,我们提供从更高质量的图像中衍生出的两个特征表示. DINOv3 SAT VIT-L/16 [36] 特征作为平面神经特征图发布,维护了航空图像的持续空间组织,而不是被裁剪或与单个自负框架相配合. UNet++ [45] 来自表6中膨胀的特征作为以自我为中心的60×30 m 60\text\times}30\text\,}\-mathrm{m}与机上坐标系统一致的作物提供. 其布局是在最近的制图方法中使用的空中投入[8、18、20、19、13],
能够以最小程度的适应方式实现一体化。

blocks.en: The release therefore comprises 20 cm / px 20\text{\,}\mathrm{cm}\text{/}\mathrm{px} RGB imagery, spatially continuous DINOv3 feature tiles, and frame-aligned UNet++ feature crops, complemented by tools for flexible aerial crop extraction. Together, these representations provide a common basis for the three research directions considered in this work.
blocks.zh: 因此,发布内容包括20cm/px 20\text~,}\mathrm{cm}\text{/}\mathrm{px} RGB成像,空间连续的DINOv3特征瓦片,和相框相接的UNet++特征作物,并辅以灵活的航空作物提取工具. 这些陈述共同为这项工作中考虑的三个研究方向提供了共同的基础。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验结果

blocks.en:
We demonstrate the versatility of the KITScenes Aerial dataset by showing experiments and state-of-the-art results across three distinct research questions.
The first and main application is to construct HD maps from a combination of aerial imagery and onboard vehicle sensor data.
Additionally, we benchmark how to construct HD maps from aerial imagery alone, a task that suffers from occlusions.
The third application powered by KITScenes Aerial is cross-view localization, i.e . , the task to match onboard sensor and aerial imagery data. All reported experiments use the KITScenes early release, with updated evaluations on the full dataset planned.
blocks.zh:
我们通过在三个不同的研究问题上展示实验和最新结果,展示了KITScenes航空数据集的多功能性。
第一个和主要应用是从航空图象和机载传感器数据组合而成的HD地图.
此外,我们确定如何仅从空中图像中构建HD地图,这项任务受到隔离的影响。
KITScenes Air为第三个应用提供动力是横视本地化,即匹配机载传感器和航空图像数据的任务. 所有报告的实验都使用KITScenes的早期发布,并计划对整个数据集进行更新评价.

blocks.en: 4.2 Aerial HD Map Construction
blocks.zh: 4.2 空中HD地图建设

blocks.en: With its rich HD map designed and ready for autonomous driving, KITScenes Aerial is a challenging benchmark for aerial-only vector map construction and rasterized HD map segmentation.
blocks.zh: 由于其丰富的HD地图被设计并准备自主驾驶,KITScenes Airrair是空中专用矢量地图构建和光栅化的HD地图分区化的挑战基准.

blocks.en:
This is underlined by the results in Tab. 4 , which report results from an AerialFusionMapNet variant using only aerial imagery.
It achieves 4.3 mAP on the 53-class KITScenes benchmark, with the strongest performance on Road Markings (9.5 AP) and Lane Markings (8.1 AP). The gap to onboard and fused variants, particularly in topology, highlights the difficulty of direct fine-grained vector map construction from aerial imagery alone.

它在53等的KITScens基准上实现了4.3 mAP,在"道路标记"(9.5 AP)和"巷道标记"(8.1 AP)上表现最强. 与机上和引信变体的差距,特别是在地形学上的差距,突出了仅从空中图像直接绘制精细矢量图的困难。

blocks.en:
In Fig. 4 , we demonstrate the suitability of the released high-resolution DINOv3 encoded imagery features for fine-grained mapping related tasks.
For this, city-scale maps are rasterized onto 8 cm / px 8\text{\,}\mathrm{cm}\text{/}\mathrm{px} tiles.
Tiles that intersect a KITScenes Multimodal validation scene map element are validation tiles, the rest of the tiles are training tiles, so the evaluation stays geographically split and aligned with the KITScenes Multimodal split.
For evaluation, the computed DINOv3 SAT ViT-L/16 [ 36 ] features are frozen as published.
Only a dense DPT [ 33 ] segmentation head is trained on the task of global rasterized HD map segmentation similar to HDMapNet [ 22 ] using the 53 map element classes. Tab. 8 reports the segmentation results (mIoU) in the native fine-grained class label space and provides the OpenSatMap [ 44 ] segmentation results as a proxy comparative value, when the KITScenes Aerial labelspace is remapped to the OpenSatMap [ 44 ] label convention. Fig. 4 and Fig. 5 provide a visual representation of these metric results in the respective validation split data.

KITScenes 多式联运验证场景地图元素相交的平面是验证平面,其余平面是训练平面,因此评价在地理上保持不变并和KITScenes多式联运平面一致.
为评价起见,已公布计算出的DINOv3 SAT VIT-L/16[36]特性被冻结。
只有密集的 DPT [33] 分片头接受过关于全球光栅化HD地图分片任务的培训,类似于HDMapNet [22] 使用53个地图元素类. Tab. 8在原生的细纹类标签空间中报告了分块结果(mIoU),并提供了OpenSatMap [44]分块结果作为代理比较值,当KITScenes空域标签空间被重新映射到OpenSatMap [44]分块公约时. 图4和图5在相应的验证分解数据中提供了这些计量结果的可视化表现.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: Temporal Consistency. The effect of temporal differences between ground-level and aerial observations cannot be isolated. To minimize such discrepancies, KITScenes Aerial provides a fixed snapshot of the raw aerial tiles selected to be as temporally close as possible to the KITScenes recordings. Nevertheless, changes in road infrastructure between the respective acquisition times may remain.
blocks.zh: 时相相通. 地面观测和空中观测之间时间差异的影响不能孤立。 为了尽量减少这种差异,KITScenes Air提供了一张固定的图片,显示选取的与KITScenes录音时间尽可能相近的原始空中瓦片。 然而,道路基础设施在购置时间之间的变化可能仍然存在。

blocks.en: Higher-Resolution Imagery. The higher-resolution orthophotos used in this work cannot be redistributed as raw RGB imagery due to licensing restrictions. We therefore release precomputed neural representations that make this information available for learning-based experiments, while limiting methods that require direct access to the underlying imagery or alternative feature extractors.
blocks.zh: 高分辨率影像学. 由于许可证限制,无法将本作中使用的高分辨率正反相片作为原始RGB图像再分配. 因此,我们释放了预先计算出来的神经表达,使这种信息可用于基于学习的实验,同时限制那些要求直接取用基本图像或替代特征提取器的方法。

blocks.en: Benchmark Extensibility. KITScenes Aerial provides representative baselines and standardized interfaces for the three research directions considered in this work, facilitating the integration of KITScenes into existing aerial and cross-view methods. The presented experiments establish initial reference points for these settings and provide a foundation for broader benchmarking in future work.
blocks.zh: 基准可扩展性。 KITScenes Air为本作中考虑的三个研究方向提供了具有代表性的基线和标准化接口,为将KITScenes纳入现有的航空和交叉视野方法提供了便利. 介绍的实验为这些环境确立了初步参考点,并为今后工作中更广泛的基准工作奠定了基础。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced KITScenes Aerial as an aerial extension of KITScenes Multimodal that combines spatially associated aerial imagery with synchronized onboard sensing, vehicle poses, and detailed Lanelet2 maps.
Together, KITScenes Aerial is the first dataset that covers both high-resolution aerial imagery and driving-ready HD maps.
This provides a common data basis for aerial-only map construction, aerial-assisted online HD mapping, and cross-view localization.
Our experiments show that aerial context becomes particularly valuable for fine-grained and extended-range map construction, while higher-resolution aerial imagery provides further gains for detailed map elements.
Cross-view localization experiments additionally demonstrate the applicability of the dataset under geographically disjoint conditions.
Beyond the evaluated settings, the joint availability of aerial and ground-level observations opens further directions for annotation-efficient learning, such as using aerial predictions as pseudo-labels for semi-supervised map learning in otherwise unlabeled driving regions or exploiting cross-modal agreement to improve pseudo-label quality.
These findings establish KITScenes Aerial as a foundation for studying previously largely separate ground–aerial research directions and for developing new forms of cross-modal supervision.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了KITScenes Air,作为KITScenes Multimodule的空中延伸,将空间相联的航空图像与机载同步感知、飞行器姿势和详细的Lanelet2地图结合起来。
KITScenes Airal是第一个既涵盖高分辨率航空图像又涵盖驾驶准备的HD地图的数据集.
这为空中专用地图的构建,空中辅助的在线HD映射,以及横视本地化提供了共同的数据基础.
我们的实验表明,空中环境对精细和长程地图的建造特别有价值,而高分辨率的空中图像为详细的地图要素提供了进一步的收益。
交叉视图本地化实验还进一步证明了数据集在地理上脱节条件下的适用性.
除了所评价的环境外,共同提供空中和地上观测数据,为注意效率高的学习开辟了进一步的方向,例如利用空中预测作为半监督地图学习的伪标签,或者利用跨模式协议来提高伪标签的质量。
这些结论将KITScenes Air作为研究以前基本上分开的地空研究方向和开发新形式的跨模式监督的基础。
